reviews.text: Rosie is a brilliant groomer. She always takes the time with our nervous dog who loves her just not the grooming process. She looks fab after and sells very high quality chews and treats. With awesome pawesome boutique leads, harnesses and collars. Grooming our dog since she was a pup wouldn't go anywhere else.
Friendly, efficient service at a great price. I wouldn’t take my dog anywhere else.

We have been using Jemima Puddledogs for a long time now and the quality is always excellent. We have specific requirements and at all times these as met and without fuss. Timely, reasonable and professional.
Love this groomers such a friendly atmosphere can leave my wee dog honey here and not worry i know she's in safe hands

Rosie was amazing with Mylo for his first ever groom! Very friendly and great recommendations for little gifts and treats for him plus a cute little bandana too! Highly recommend to anyone that has an anxious dog
